create_boost_test_instance: create a BoostBuild Tester instance that sets up a temporary working directory for B2 tests
write_test_files: write a jamroot.jam build file and source files into the test temporary directory using Tester.write
run_b2_build: run the B2 build system to compile a project and verify output files are created
assert_file_addition: assert that expected build output files were added after running the B2 build system
run_b2_clean_and_assert_removal: run the B2 build system with clean target and assert previously built files were removed
